# Gloom moth, the flyer: a khaki body, two broad dusky-rose wings (two-sided cards) and pale feelers.
# 0.86 x 0.5 x 0.2 m; origin at the body's centre (the game flies it 1.2 m up). make_env.py.
new
material new Body --base-color 0.6157 0.6235 0.4980 --no-slot
material new Wing --base-color 0.5451 0.3333 0.5020 --no-slot
material new Spot --base-color 0.7725 0.8000 0.7216 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1200 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0.0 0.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 0.900 1.600 0.900
apply --scale
translate 0.0000 0.0000 0.0000
material assign Body
add mesh cube --name WingL --size 1 --location -0.2500 0.0200 0.0200
scale 0.3600 0.3600 0.0350
apply --scale
material assign Wing
add mesh cube --name WingR --size 1 --location 0.2500 0.0200 0.0200
scale 0.3600 0.3600 0.0350
apply --scale
material assign Wing
add mesh cube --name SpotL --size 1 --location -0.2800 0.0400 0.0450
scale 0.1200 0.1200 0.0200
apply --scale
material assign Spot
add mesh cube --name SpotR --size 1 --location 0.2800 0.0400 0.0450
scale 0.1200 0.1200 0.0200
apply --scale
material assign Spot
add mesh cube --name Feel --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.2500 0.0700
scale 0.2000 0.0600 0.0500
apply --scale
material assign Spot
select all
shade flat
export moth.glb
